entities.name: Militech Offices
entities.source_summary: Militech's Pacifica Confederation headquarters is a heavily restricted corporate complex; select visitors meet staff in an ancillary facility that also contains a client showroom for demonstrations and purchases.

entities.name: Militech Client Showroom
entities.source_summary: Source-explicit but unnamed showroom in the visitor meeting facility where Militech gives selected clients demonstrations and sells products.

local_offerings.label: Militech products offered to selected clients

entities.catalogue_note: The source supports select-client direct sales but this pass does not generate a broad Militech shelf without a hard manufacturer allowlist and access-aware stock visibility.

entities.name: The Oaks
entities.source_summary: Residential neighborhood for base personnel, ranging from group barracks and officer quarters to family apartments and high-ranking officers' houses; assignment depends on status rather than public commerce.

entities.name: The Rec Center
entities.source_summary: Base recreation center combining bowling, arcade, gym, mini-golf, movie theater and a reconfigurable outdoor sports field.
